name: MAX333AEUP+T
title: MAX333A precision quad SPDT CMOS analog switch
summary: The MAX333A holds four separate SPDT analog switches, each with its own logic input, in a 20-pin package. It runs on split rails of ±4.5 V to ±20 V or a single rail of +10 V to +30 V, with signals swinging rail to rail. On resistance is 35 Ω max at ±15 V and 25 °C, matched between channels within 2 Ω and flat within 3 Ω across the signal range. MAX333AEUP is the -40 °C to +85 °C grade in 20-pin TSSOP.
key_figures: ±4.5 V to ±20 V dual; +10 V to +30 V single
20 Ω typ, 35 Ω max (M); 45 Ω max (C, E); ±15 V, 25 °C
0.25 nA max (M) at 25 °C; 6 nA max over temperature (C, E)

notes: Dice specifications are available from the factory.

circuits.title: Flying-capacitor level translator, two channels
circuits.description: Two differential voltages, V1 - V2 and V3 - V4, are each moved onto a ground-referenced output. Each channel uses two of the four switches and two capacitors. One clock drives all four logic inputs together. With the inputs low, the NC sides close and the flying capacitor (C1 or C3) charges to the input difference. With the inputs high, the NO sides close and the flying capacitor is laid across the hold capacitor (C2 or C4), whose low end is ground, so the hold capacitor settles at the input difference.
notes: No capacitor values are given.
OSC IN is a square wave.

circuits.title: Overvoltage protection with blocking diodes
circuits.description: For use where the supplies cannot be brought up in the order V+, VL, V-, logic inputs: a small-signal diode sits in series with each supply pin, D1 from the V+ rail into the V+ pin and D2 from the V- pin out to the V- rail. A source Vg drives COM against ground; NO or NC is the output. With the diodes in place the analog range ends 1 V inside each rail, and on resistance and leakage are unchanged.
notes: COM1 and NO1 stand for any switch's COM_ and NO_ or NC_.

circuits.title: Switching-time test circuit
circuits.description: NC_ is held at +10 V and NO_ at -10 V; COM_ drives a 300 Ω load to ground. IN_ is driven by a 0 V to 3 V logic pulse with rise and fall under 20 ns. tON and tOFF run from the 50% point of the logic edge to the 50% point of the output edge; tOPEN is the gap during which the output sits near 0 V between the two levels. Each switch is tested in turn.

parts.note: logic pulse, 0 V to 3 V, tR and tF < 20 ns

circuits.title: Channel-off capacitance
circuits.description: With the switch held open by IN_ (0 V or 2.4 V), a capacitance meter is switched to COM_ or to NO_/NC_ and reads that terminal's capacitance to ground. Each supply pin has a capacitor C to ground.
notes: NO1 stands for NO_ or NC_.

circuits.title: Channel-on capacitance
circuits.description: With the switch closed by IN_ (0 V or 2.4 V), the capacitance meter is switched to COM_ or to NO/NC and reads the capacitance of the closed channel to ground. Each supply pin has a capacitor C to ground.
notes: NO1 stands for NO or NC.

circuits.title: Break-before-make test circuit
circuits.description: COM_ is held at VCOM. NO and NC each drive RL = 1000 Ω in parallel with CL = 35 pF to ground, giving outputs VO1 and VO2. A 0 V to +3 V logic pulse drives IN_. tD is the time from one output falling to 90% to the other output rising to 90%, at each edge. CL counts stray and fixture capacitance too.
notes: The switch rests in its logic-0 state.

circuits.title: Charge injection test circuit
circuits.description: A source VGEN through RGEN feeds COM_; NC or NO drives the output VO, loaded by CL = 10 nF to ground. A logic pulse switches IN_ on, off and on again. The step ΔVO at the output when the switch opens, times CL, is the injected charge.
notes: Q = (ΔVO)(CL).
NO1 stands for NC or NO.

circuits.title: Off-isolation test circuit
circuits.description: A 1 MHz signal from an automatic synthesizer drives COM_ over coaxial cable and also feeds analyzer channel A. With the switch held open by IN_ (0 V or 2.4 V), NC_ or NO_ is loaded by RL = 100 Ω and read on analyzer channel B, a tracking spectrum analyzer. Each supply pin has a capacitor C = 5 pF to ground.

parts.note: tracking spectrum analyzer, channels A and B

notes: Off isolation = 20log(VCOM / VNC or VNO).
NC1 stands for NC_ or NO_.

circuits.title: Crosstalk test circuit
circuits.description: A 1 MHz signal drives the COM of one switch, whose NC or NO is terminated in 50 Ω; analyzer channel A reads the drive. Switch 1, its COM left open, has its NC1 or NO1 loaded by RL = 100 Ω and read on analyzer channel B. Both logic inputs are set to 0 V or 2.4 V. Each supply pin has a capacitor C to ground. The test is repeated for the other channels.

parts.note: tracking spectrum analyzer, channels A and B

notes: Switch 2 stands for the driven channel; NO2 and NO1 stand for NC or NO.

where.ΔVO: output step when the switch opens

operation.text: Four independent single-pole double-throw switches. A low logic input closes COM to NC; a high input closes COM to NO. Break-before-make action is built in, 10 ns typical. Logic and analog terminals may sit anywhere between the two supplies without harm.
The logic inputs accept TTL and CMOS levels: 0.8 V and 2.4 V thresholds hold whatever the supply voltage.

Bipolar supplies from ±4.5 V to ±20 V, or one supply from +10 V to +30 V with V- at 0 V. The part also runs from a single +10 V to +24 V supply and from unbalanced pairs such as +24 V with -5 V. Below ±15 V the usable analog range shrinks with the rails, and at ±5 V switching takes at least twice as long.
Supply current stays under 50 µA with every logic input high or low; power consumption is 3.75 mW.

Bring V+ up first, then VL, V- and the logic inputs. Where that order cannot be kept, a small-signal diode in series with each supply pin protects the part; the analog range then stops 1 V short of each rail while on resistance and leakage are unchanged.
Offered as an upgraded replacement for a DG211 and DG212 pair, or for two DG403 parts.
ESD tolerance above 2000 V, by method 3015.7.
Die 0.101 in by 0.139 in (2.57 mm by 3.53 mm), 145 transistors, substrate tied to V+. Dice are listed as MAX333AC/D; their specifications come from the factory.
Test equipment, communications systems, PBX and PABX, heads-up displays, portable instruments.
